analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc decomposition of five external candidate stress outputs; no refitting or new experiment

decomposition_rule.identity: For every available point, residual_upper_bound = actual_absolute_residual + prediction_shift_upper_bound within numerical tolerance
decomposition_rule.zero_bound: If actual residual, shift and bound are all zero, retain an undefined share rather than assigning 0 percent
decomposition_rule.classification: prediction_shift_dominant when share >= 0.5; snapshot_residual_dominant when share < 0.5; undefined_zero_bound otherwise
decomposition_rule.gauss1_regression: Reproduce all four non-null same-point maxima from validation/gauss1-bound-mechanism.json

scope_rule.chwirut1_increment: Add 214 total points, 83 available points, 131 unavailable points, 75 prediction-shift dominant points and 8 snapshot-residual dominant points
scope_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 was not used in previous region design, but shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; it is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning or changing of frozen bounds
No conversion of unavailable points into zero bounds or zero shares
No probability, variance-decomposition or physical-mechanism interpretation of arithmetic shares
No universal ranking of datasets, native-model validity claims or erasure of Chwirut1/Chwirut2 relatedness
